<span style="font-size: 0.85em;">
**Disclaimer:** This is research in progress. Estimates are based on data from 2024 and are adjusted to reflect house price changes up to June 2026. The estimates give a guideline but they cannot provide precise predictions. Only houses below $3,000,000 were considered because higher priced houses crucially depend on individual properties Therefore, predictions for high priced houses are less reliable.The same is true for houses with a very low price. 
</span>
:::





## At a Glance

Based on your chosen house size and location  a machine learning [**Gradient Boosting Trees**](https://ai.lange-analytics.com/htmlbook/TreeBased.html){target="_blank"}  model was used to predict the house price. 

Afterward, a game theory based algorithm [**SHAP**](https://ai.lange-analytics.com/htmlbook/Interpret.html#Interpret-Shap) was used to calculate premiums and discounts to be paid for the presence or lack of certain amenities. 
Cumulatively, all premiums and discounts  explain the difference between an average house in Los Angeles County and the predicted house price.

## Detailed Report

The detailed report features will be finalized soon and they are currently in the state of *work in progress*.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
### House Scale and Layout

You are analyzing a house with the following properties:\
**Sqft:** {{ Sqft | digit0_format }}, **Number of Bedrooms:** {{ Bedrooms }}

An average house in Los Angeles County has the following properties:\
**Sqft::**  {{ AvgSqft  | digit0_format }},
**Number of Bedrooms:** {{ AvgBedrooms  | digit0_format }}

*Sqft* and number of *Bedrooms* are closely correlated. Therefore, it is not possible to isolate each variables influence on the housing price. To still consider both variates they were transformed in two uncorrelated [**Principle Components**](https://aashu-aggarwal.medium.com/from-scattered-to-simple-how-pca-finds-order-in-data-chaos-d5d46e371a71){target="_blank"} . Cumulatively  *Sqft* and *Bedrooms* result in a\
**Total SHAP Premium(+)/ Discount (-) of {{ SHAPPCA1PCA2 | currency_format }}**

In many (but not all!) cases  the **first Principal Component's SHAP Value ({{ SHAPPCA1 | currency_format }} )** represents the premium(+)/discount(-)  for the **Scale** (the "bigness") of a house, while the **second Principal Component's SHAP Value ({{ SHAPPCA2 | currency_format }})** represents the premium(+)/discount(-) for the **Layout** (ratio between sqft and bedrooms) of a house.

**Note:** an average sized house will result in small *SHAP* Premiums(+)/Discounts(-), but due to the non-linear nature of the [*Gradient Boosting Trees*](https://example.com){target="_blank"} algorithm, *SHAP* values will not be zero.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
### Drive Time to the Next Beach in Minutes and BeachTime SHAP Value

From the selected house to the closest beach ({{ BeachName }}) the\
**Drive time  is {{ BeachTime  | digit0_format }} Min.**\ 

In Los Angeles County  the\ 
**Average (geom.) DriveTime is {{ GeoAvgBeachTime  | digit0_format }} Min.**

**Resulting Beach Time SHAP Premium (+)/Discount(-) is {{ SHAPBeachTimeLN | currency_format }}**

**Note:** a house with a drive time to the next beach that equals the Los Angeles County average will have a small Beach Time *SHAP* Premium(+)/Discount(-). However, due to the non-linear nature of the [*Gradient Boosting Trees*](https://example.com){target="_blank"} algorithm, the *SHAP* value will not be zero.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
### School Quality Index and Resulting SHAP Premium (+)/Discount(-)

School quality is expressed with an index. The index is 100 for the best high school in Los Angeles County and 0 for the worst high school. 

**School Quality for the nearest high school from the selected neighborhood (Census Tract):** {{ (((SchoolQuality - 2407.70) / (2784.40 - 2407.70)) * 100) | digit0_format }}\
**Average School Quality in Los Angeles County:**  {{ (((AvgSchoolQuality - 2407.70) / (2784.40 - 2407.70)) * 100) | digit0_format }}

**Resulting SHAP Premium (+)/Discount (-):** {{ SHAPSchoolQuality | currency_format }}

**Note:** a house with a School Quality that equals the average in Los Angeles County  will have a small *SHAP* Premium(+)/Discounts(-), but due to the non-linear nature of the [*Gradient Boosting Trees*](https://example.com){target="_blank"} algorithm, the *SHAP* value will not be zero.

Data Source: @@@

### Median Income


**Median Income in the selected neighborhood (Census Tract) is:**\
{{ MedIncome  | currency_format }}

**Average *Median Income  in Los Angeles County is:**/  {{ AvgMedIncome  | currency_format }}\
**Resulting *Premium (+)*/*Discount (-)*:** {{ SHAPMedIncome | currency_format }}

The *Premium (+)*/*Discount (-)* does not only reflect the direct effect of median income on house prices. It also includes unobserved house and neighborhood properties like repair status and amenities in the neighborhood that are correlated with income.
